description: A drawer navigator allows navigation between screens via a side drawer (usually from the left, sometimes right).

usage.staticAPI: createDrawerNavigator(config) returns a Drawer Navigator object with Navigator and Screen components.
usage.dynamicAPI: Use <Drawer.Navigator> and <Drawer.Screen> in your component tree.

methods.Navigator: Component wrapping all drawer screens and managing navigation state.
methods.Screen: Component representing an individual screen in the drawer navigator.

props.initialRouteName: Name of the first screen to display.
props.drawerType: 'front', 'back', 'slide', or 'permanent'. Controls the drawer animation and presentation style.
props.drawerStyle: Style object for the drawer content (width, backgroundColor, etc.).
props.drawerContentOptions: Object specifying styling for labels, active/inactive tint colors, badges, etc.
props.drawerContent: Function returning a custom drawer content component.
props.edgeWidth: Width of the touchable area to open drawer via swipe gesture.
props.minSwipeDistance: Minimum swipe distance required to open the drawer.
props.hideStatusBar: Boolean to hide the status bar when drawer opens (default false).
props.overlayColor: Color of the overlay when the drawer is open.
props.sceneContainerStyle: Style object for the container wrapping screen content.

hooks.useDrawerStatus: Returns the current drawer status: 'open' or 'closed'.

events.drawerToggle: Fired when the drawer is toggled.

notes: Use drawer helper methods on the navigation prop or dispatch DrawerActions manually.
Custom drawer content can be rendered using drawerContent prop.
drawerType controls the animation and presentation style for the drawer.
Use edgeWidth and minSwipeDistance to control gesture sensitivity.
